steps.reason: Scope the full dataset before computing any per-account statistics. No explicit filters were given, so all accounts and dates are included.
Compute per-account rolling amount z-scores to identify transactions that are statistically large relative to each account's own baseline — the core signal for this query.
Apply the high_risk_amount rule to flag accounts/transactions whose z-scores or absolute amounts exceed defined thresholds.

Because the query is broad ('unusually large for the account') with no specific typology or threshold, the anomaly model adds value by catching outliers that rule thresholds might miss across the full population.
Combine rule hits and anomaly scores into a final LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk rating per flagged account, making results prioritisable for the analyst.
